name: Lutron Caseta
description: Control Lutron Caseta lighting: activate scenes, toggle Smart Away, inspect devices/areas/occupancy via the lutron CLI.

bridgeHost.description: Bridge IP or hostname (overrides lutron-cli config)

confirmAllOff.description: Require an interactive confirmation before the lutron_all_off whole-home kill switch fires.

confirmStateChanges.description: Also require confirmation before every individual state-changing tool (set level/fan/cover/warm-dim, activate scene, tap button, Smart Away on/off), not just the bulk kill switch.

allowUnattended.description: Permit confirmation-gated actions to run in headless/automation contexts where no interactive UI exists to confirm. Leave off so an unattended agent (or prompt injection) cannot silently sweep the home off.

cliPath.label: CLI Path
cliPath.help: Path or command name for the lutron binary. Install via `pipx install lutron-cli`.

bridgeHost.label: Bridge Host
bridgeHost.help: IP of your Smart Bridge (e.g. 192.168.1.50). Leave blank to use the lutron-cli config default.

confirmAllOff.label: Confirm All Off
confirmAllOff.help: Ask before turning off the whole home with lutron_all_off. Recommended on.

confirmStateChanges.label: Confirm Every Change
confirmStateChanges.help: Ask before each individual light/shade/fan/scene change too. Off by default.

allowUnattended.label: Allow Unattended
allowUnattended.help: Let confirmation-gated actions run when no UI is available to confirm (trusted automation only).
